patch.value: Annotate text lines and structured fields with native change provenance
Add pm vcs annotate <path> using Phase 6 stable file identities and PM attribution. Attribute per line for text and per FIELD for records, including across renames and rewrites.

TOON and JSON name change id, author, agent harness/model provenance and linked pm item for every line or field; rename/copy and rewritten histories retain correct attribution; unresolved units report their multiple origins.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Plan: add immutable text-line and structured field/list-entry annotation using stable FileIds, following renames and copy ancestry. Walk only parents of the selected revision; cache immutable metadata/payloads and stop once requested units have origins. Read PM harness/model provenance from the owning change snapshot history where recorded; retain explicit commit item links and native item identity. Group adjacent text rows by origin by default, expose --full and --at, and report unresolved side origins. Instrument actual object reads on a 2000-change synthetic history. PR 1 is pushed as #125 with CI running; this branch starts independently from main.
